title: Break-glass posture: an elicited bypass-service-auth pair authenticates CI automation
asA: operator running CI-signed automation against an Access-gated Worker
iWant: an elicited bypass-service-auth token pair that the validator recognises and passes through as an authenticated principal
soThat: CI can hit the gated Worker without a browser flow while every bypass leaves a distinct audit trace

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the request presents the elicited service-auth id and secret (as CF-Access-Client-Id and CF-Access-Client-Secret headers), the validator observes the pair, records outcome=bypass in the audit event with the metadata-only shape, and delegates to the handler as authenticated with request.auth.email='service:'+id. Break-glass is disabled unless the elicited pair is applied. Applying agent sets: the applying agent sets the elicited access-bypass-service-auth-id and its paired secret; the bypass observable (delegates as authenticated with request.auth.email='service:'+id) is a pure function of that pair.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the createAccessValidator wired with an elicited bypass-service-auth pair and a request presenting the paired headers
acceptanceCriteria.when: the request dispatches through the validator
acceptanceCriteria.then: the handler receives request.auth with the service principal and the audit sink records outcome=bypass with allowed keys only

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given no bypass-service-auth id is elicited (empty string, break-glass disabled), when a request presents CF-Access-Client-Id and CF-Access-Client-Secret headers, the validator ignores the bypass path entirely and falls through to normal JWT validation; the audit event carries outcome:"reject" reason:"jwt-missing" when no JWT accompanies the headers, never outcome:"bypass".
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture applied source with break-glass disabled (access-bypass-service-auth-id empty)
acceptanceCriteria.when: a request presents CF-Access-Client-Id and CF-Access-Client-Secret headers but no Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion
acceptanceCriteria.then: the validator refuses 401 with outcome "reject" reason "jwt-missing"; no bypass principal is set and no outcome "bypass" audit event fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the elicited break-glass service-auth pair is present, when a request presents CF-Access-Client-Id that does not match the elicited id and any CF-Access-Client-Secret, the validator refuses 401 with outcome:"reject" reason:"bypass-id-mismatch"; no bypass principal is set on request.auth and no outcome:"bypass" audit event fires. Applying agent sets: the applying agent sets the elicited access-bypass-service-auth-id; a request whose CF-Access-Client-Id differs from the applied value is refused with bypass-id-mismatch.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture applied source with break-glass enabled and the elicited id and secret configured
acceptanceCriteria.when: a request presents a wrong CF-Access-Client-Id with any secret
acceptanceCriteria.then: the validator refuses 401 with outcome "reject" reason "bypass-id-mismatch" and no bypass principal is set

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the elicited break-glass service-auth pair is present, when a request presents the correct CF-Access-Client-Id with a wrong CF-Access-Client-Secret, the validator refuses 401 with outcome:"reject" reason:"bypass-secret-mismatch" using a constant-time compare; no bypass principal is set and no outcome:"bypass" audit event fires. Applying agent sets: the applying agent sets the elicited paired secret; a request whose CF-Access-Client-Secret differs from the applied value is refused with bypass-secret-mismatch under a constant-time compare.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture applied source with break-glass enabled and the elicited pair configured
acceptanceCriteria.when: a request presents the correct client id but a wrong secret
acceptanceCriteria.then: the validator refuses 401 with outcome "reject" reason "bypass-secret-mismatch" and no bypass principal is set

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the elicited break-glass service-auth pair is present, when a request presents only one of CF-Access-Client-Id or CF-Access-Client-Secret (never both), the validator falls through to normal JWT validation and refuses 401 with outcome:"reject" reason:"jwt-missing" (or whichever JWT-path reason applies); no partial-bypass principal is set and no outcome:"bypass" audit event fires. Applying agent sets: the applying agent sets both halves of the elicited bypass pair; a request presenting only one half falls through to JWT validation and is refused with the appropriate JWT-path reason.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture applied source with break-glass enabled and the elicited pair configured
acceptanceCriteria.when: a request presents exactly one of CF-Access-Client-Id or CF-Access-Client-Secret
acceptanceCriteria.then: the validator falls through to JWT validation; no bypass principal is set and no bypass audit event fires
